<function name="SetMinHeight" parent="DTileLayout" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Determines the minimum height the DTileLayout will resize to. This is useful if child panels will be added/removed often.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="minH" type="number">The minimum height the panel can shrink to.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
